description.zh:
云电脑的授权用户名列表。可设置1~100个。

> 在同一时段内，只有一个用户可以连接和使用该云电脑。
description.en:
The IDs of the end users of the cloud computer. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs.

>  During a specific period of time, only one user can connect to and use the cloud computer.

description.zh: 包年包月云电脑的到期时间。
description.en: The time when a subscription cloud computer expires.

description.zh: 云电脑所属的云电脑池ID。
description.en: The ID of the cloud computer pool to which the cloud computers belong.

description.zh:
分页查询时每页行数。

最大值：100。

默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of entries per page.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.

description.zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个。
description.en: The token that is used for the next query. If this parameter is empty, all results are returned.
The ID of the policy that is attached to the cloud computer.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 标签列表。一个标签由一对键值对组成，用于标记资源。您可以使用标签来分组管理云电脑，便于搜索和批量操作，详情参见[使用标签管理云电脑](~~203781~~)。
description.en: The tags that are added to the cloud computer. A tag is a key-value pair that consists of a tag key and a tag value. Tags are used to identify resources. You can use tags to manage cloud computers by group. This facilitates search and batch operations. For more information, see [Use tags to manage cloud computers](~~203781~~).

description.zh: 标签键。如果传入`Tag`，则`Key`是必填的。不可超过128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`，也不能仅包含空格。
description.en: The tag key. If you specify the `Tag` parameter, you must also specify the `Key` parameter. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag key cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun` and cannot contain only spaces.

description.zh: 标签值。不可超过128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The tag value. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag value cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`.

description.zh: 当前正在使用云电脑的用户名。
description.en: The username of the end user who is using the cloud computer.

descriptions.zh:
调用本接口导出的云电脑列表将保存为CSV文件，每条云电脑数据包括以下字段：

- 云电脑ID/云电脑名称
- 办公网络ID/办公网络名称
- 规格/系统/协议
- 系统盘/数据盘
- 状态
- 购买方式
- 过期时间
- 剩余时长/总时长
- 分配用户数/当前使用用户
- 办公网络类型
- 创建时间
- 标签
- 是否加密
- IP
- 主机名
descriptions.en:
The cloud computer list exported by calling this operation is saved as a CSV file. Each entry of data of a cloud computer includes the following fields:

*   Cloud computer ID and name
*   Office network ID and name
*   The instance type, OS and protocol of the cloud computer
*   System disk and data disk of the cloud computer
*   The status
*   Purchase method
*   The time when the cloud computer expires
*   Remaining duration and total duration
*   Number of assigned users and number of current users
*   Office network type
*   The time when the cloud computer was created
*   Tags
*   Encryption status
*   IP
*   The hostname
